title: UFO experts claims US authorities 'aren't doing their job'
byline: UFO experts claims US authorities 'aren't doing their job'
excerpt: A UFO expert has declared US authorities arent doing their job if they cant explain the mysterious objects in our skies.
content:
1 October 2026

A UFO expert has declared US authorities "aren't doing their job" if they can't explain the mysterious objects in our skies.

Are officials taking UFOs seriously?

Professor Avi Loeb of Harvard University, who is a leading US astrophysicist who sits on the UAP Science Advisory Council, has given his thoughts on the scale of the reporting of UAPs (unidentified anomalous phenomena) in documents released by the Pentagon and insisted officials need to take the investigation into the sightings more serious.

He told Popular Mechanics magazine: "The Pentagon is unable to tell us what some objects in the sky are, so they’re not doing their job. That’s a serious matter."

In the interview, Loeb also shrugged off criticism of his views on UFOs from the scientific community and insisted he's not afraid to speak his mind on such an important subject.

It comes after Loeb suggested glowing orbs seen in the sky could be a "warp drive" used by alien space craft as a transportation mechanism.

During an appearance on NewsNation, he explained: "If they have a cargo transportation system between habitable planets within their planetary system, we might see flashes of light from the beamer of a light sail.

"Technology that we can imagine. We don’t have such a system as of yet, but they may have it. In addition, they may also use for transportation a warp drive.

"That’s a bubble of distorted space-time that allows one to carry a cargo at an arbitrary speed across interstellar distances ...

"If a warp bubble passes through the Earth’s atmosphere, it would cause a disturbance and produce a glowing ball of air. "

He added: "In fact, there are reports in the Presidential Unsealing and Reporting System for UAP Encounters from the U.S. government, including excellent work by the All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) in the Pentagon, about orbs.

"These are mysterious glowing spheres that they appear to be seeing and the FBI and other government agencies are reporting about.

"It’s not at all clear what some of these orbs are. Some of them might be drones but others are definitely not drones. And so it’s a detective story for us to figure out what technology might be employed if these orbs came from outer space."
